Definition: of Hebrew origin (H2332); Eua (or Eva, i.e. Chavvah), the first woman:--Eve.
BiblicalUsage: Eûa is Eve, the first woman, the mother of all living. Paul points back to her when he warns the Corinthians not to be led astray as the serpent beguiled Eve, and again when he writes that Adam was formed first, then Eve. Her fuller story is on her People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eve matters because the whole story starts with her: the first woman, the first deception, and the first promise that her seed would bruise the serpent's head.
